audience: Software builders who want to turn an idea into useful, expressive behavior
brief: Give this pocket pet a job. Tell a playful MiniMax Code CLI example through its real timer-ready, held-paused and happy-completion states. Make the changing face the memory point, with authentic early branding and beat-led music, not a generic feature inventory.

facts.text: MiniMax describes Coding and Work modes for its coding harness.
The product page describes agents teaming up to tackle tasks.
The product description includes working with images, video and audio, and creating scripts and voiceovers.
In the documented MiniMax Code CLI example, the first request adds a Pomodoro timer to an existing browser pet.
The follow-up requests hold-to-pause behavior for that timer.
The same example adds a completion celebration, shown by the happy pet in the browser footage.
This is a CLI example using an existing starter and BYOK. The maintainer finished the visual design; the visibly labeled ten-second demo is not generation time.

notes: Owner rejected both the generic role relay and the three-showcase pocket-pet candidate. Music now lands on the beats; retain that improvement. The remaining defects are long static holds, a meaningless blue ROI outline, and an uninteresting visual story. Motion reference: https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion/blob/main/docs/media/claude-duet.gif — use its changing scale, composition and connected subject handoffs as direction only; do not copy its character, marks or imagery. Use the approved real ready/paused/celebrate states as one evolving product story, not three independent static cards. ui-journey with beatFrames can connect distinct real states with camera handoffs; keep each headline short and the subject large, with reading intervals rather than long frozen shots. Do not use focus ROI boxes in this revision. These inputs are stills from an edited official demo, not live interaction footage; do not invent timer movement or new UI behavior. The empty desktop screenshot and Coding/Work/Media inventory are not the story. Required readable on-screen credit once: "CLI example · Maintainer-finished visuals". Do not claim the starter or visual design was generated from scratch, call the pet a MiniMax logo or physical device, or confuse the visible ten-second timer with generation time. No test-count, speed, cost or outcome guarantees. Retain audible procedural funk at 100 BPM and beat-aligned visual arrivals; a short chime may mark the happy face. Use the authentic cleared MiniMax Code mark early and at the ending. Preserve Explore MiniMax Code and agent.minimax.io exactly. Keep the confirmed facts intact; only choose the ones needed for this story.
